title: Khivan campaign of 1873
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Khivan campaign of 1873", at revision 1370625716, opens: "In the Russo-Khivan War of 1873, Russia conquered the Khanate of Khiva, and it became a Russian protectorate." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4497452, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Russian campaign of Central Asia 1873 to colonize Khanate of Khiva". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
